parsed.post: Discarding latest run (0.9893) as it regressed from 0.9872. The small increase in val_bpb suggests my current configuration is at a local plateau or the learning rate is slightly suboptimal for this capacity. Reverting to DEPTH=8, ASPECT_RATIO=48, MATRIX_LR=0.03, WARMUP_RATIO=0.1. Next: test MATRIX_LR=0.02 to see if slower optimization helps.
parsed.description: Decreasing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.02 to see if more conservative steps improve stability and convergence for the DEPTH=8 model.
